card.name: Inside proper names and acronyms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a capitalized surname or acronym that is split into parts, such as Gil|mer, Gel|man, Cull|man, GFA|J or CP|K. It appears in non-medical web text such as law, politics and science news.

modes.label: Split surnames
modes.description: Final piece of a surname written in several parts, often in citations or place lists.
modes.example: Andrew Gel<<man>>, Nate Silver, and Aaron Edlin

modes.label: Split acronyms
modes.description: Last letter or letters of an abbreviation or lab code.

card.plain: It fires on the end of an unusual name or abbreviation that the model reads in pieces, such as a surname or a lab code.
